title: Namaz e Maghferat e Waledain
introduction:
NAMAZ E MAGHFERAT E WALEDAIN

The prayer for the parents is of two units. It is highly recommended to seek forgiveness and pray for one’s parents during their lifetime and after their demise.

verses.translation: In the first unit, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and the following supplicatory prayer is repeated ten times:

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْلِىْ وَ لِوَالِدَىَّ وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الْحِسَابُ۔
verses.translation: O my Lord! (please) Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.
In the second unit, Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and the following supplicatory prayer is repeated ten times:
O my Lord! (Please) forgive me and my parents
and him who enters my house believing,
and the believing men and the believing women
When the prayer is accomplished (by uttering the Taslim statement), the following supplicatory prayer is repeated ten times:
O my Lord! Have compassion on them, as they brought me up (when I was) little.
